cases.name: exact integer arithmetic
cases.purpose: Integers are exact and factor completely.

cases.name: the last line and what was printed
cases.purpose: The value of the last line comes back in result, and print() output in stdout.

cases.name: a statement has no value
cases.purpose: Code that ends with an assignment is a statement, with no result.

cases.name: variables persist within a scope
cases.purpose: What one call defines, the next call of the same scope sees: the model builds an object once and explores it.

cases.name: each scope starts empty
cases.purpose: A new scope does not have the names of others (here, the petersen of the case before), so provers do not share state, and a name it has not assigned is refused rather than silently empty.

fails.matches: 'petersen' is not a name this server offers

cases.name: a letter not assigned is a symbol
cases.purpose: A single letter the scope has not assigned becomes a symbolic variable, as the description warns; this is why it asks for longer names.

cases.name: graphs up to isomorphism
cases.purpose: Graph enumeration, for small models: graphs on 1 to 6 vertices.

cases.name: the small groups library
cases.purpose: GAP's SmallGroups library, through SmallPermutationGroup: the groups of order 8.

cases.name: number theory
cases.purpose: PARI and primecount: prime counting, totients, Bernoulli numbers.

cases.name: symbolic sums
cases.purpose: Maxima works (passagemath shipped a broken Maxima in 10.8.10 and 10.8.11).

cases.name: exact linear algebra
cases.purpose: Matrices over the rationals stay exact.

cases.name: a SAT solver
cases.purpose: SAT() answers False on an unsatisfiable formula.

cases.name: errors come back with their message
cases.purpose: The model sees why its code failed.

cases.name: imports are refused
cases.purpose: Defence in depth: the model's code cannot reach the operating system through an import.

cases.name: files are refused
cases.purpose: Defence in depth: the model's code cannot read files.

cases.name: the call's own time limit
cases.purpose: The server stops a computation at the timeout of the input, says so, and the registry's limit has not fired yet.
